brief:
The Palestinian citizenry of Israel is organizing a significant voting bloc ahead of the 2026 election, according to Middle East Eye. Analyst Ameer Fakhoury, in an in-depth interview, examined how Palestinian citizens are mobilizing their electoral power to secure representation and advance their interests within Israel's political system.

The coordinated voting effort reflects growing Palestinian political engagement at the ballot box, as the community seeks to influence policy outcomes that affect their status and rights as citizens.

title: Palestinian citizens mobilize voting bloc for Israel's 2026 election
